dataClasses.description: The projection always declares OPERATOR_RESEARCH_EXCERPT. The server includes CONFIRMED_RESEARCH_FIELDS exactly when confirmedContext is nonempty and checks that binding before dispatch.

expiresAt.description: At most ten minutes after creation and no later than the run deadline.

providerRequestBody.description: Exact UTF-8 JSON body of the production provider request. Credentials are transport headers and are never returned.

PositiveBudget.description: Exact positive decimal USD amount no greater than 1000000.

PaperQuantity.description: Strictly positive exact decimal shares; at most nine fractional digits. Fractional DAY LIMIT additionally requires fresh certified asset capability.

PaperLimitPrice.description: Positive exact USD price; current asset tick policy is checked before planning.

nativeAmount.description: An independently denominated source amount. No USD value is inferred.

reconciliationAt.description: Last successful reconciliation of this Paper ledger revision.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next positions page within this source snapshot.

PortfolioProcessingProjectionV1.description: Minimized deterministic findings only. No accounts, raw position tables, personal preferences, prompts or credentials. Each finding references this immutable analysis revision; provider eligibility, data basis and cost decision remain independent.

PaperLimitPreviewTermsV1.description: Exact human-entered LIMIT/DAY/REGULAR terms for a non-binding preview. No confirmation or reservation occurs until guided commit.
